base: Optimism Isthmus (Ethereum Prague), as the Rex6 overview states

header.encoding: the RLP list of the header's fields in this order
header.hash: keccak256 of the encoding: the block hash

receipt.encoding: rlp([status, cumulativeGasUsed, logsBloom, logs]) for type 0x0; the type byte followed by that list for 0x1, 0x2 and 0x4; 0x7e followed by rlp([status, cumulativeGasUsed, logsBloom, logs, depositNonce, depositReceiptVersion]) for a deposit
receipt.root: receiptsRoot: the ordered Merkle-Patricia trie keyed by the RLP of each index

transaction.encoding: EIP-2718 envelopes: legacy (0x0, with or without EIP-155), EIP-2930 (0x1), EIP-1559 (0x2), EIP-7702 (0x4) and the OP Stack deposit (0x7e: sourceHash, from, to, mint, value, gas, isSystemTx, data)
transaction.root: transactionsRoot: the ordered Merkle-Patricia trie keyed by the RLP of each index

name: megaeth/Rex6
ruleIds: assigned by tools/gen_rex6_registry.py: REX6-<page area>-<ordinal of the normative block>

salt.definition: SALT's own key-to-bucket mapping, which SATIN-STATE-010 takes as an input: bucket = ahash(key) mod (buckets - metaBuckets) + metaBuckets
salt.slotKey: the account's 20 address bytes followed by the slot as 32 big-endian bytes
